_comment: academic.json — shared style definition for the Academic style.
Single-column, generous margins, classic serif throughout.
Minimal colour — black/dark-grey only. Suitable for preprints and papers.
md_harden reads 'hardening' when --style academic is passed.
md2pdf engines read 'design' for reference; rendering is in the .typ/.css files.

design._comment: Rendering decisions — implemented in academic.typ and style_academic.css.

_comment: Conventions that md_harden enforces when --style academic is passed.
Academic style uses Source: (capitalised) for pull-quote attribution,
and italicises et al. consistently per academic citation convention.

pull_quote_attribution._comment: Academic style uses capitalised Source: to match citation formality.
pull_quote_attribution.action: Normalise 'source:' -> 'Source:'. Capitalised form matches academic citation style.

et_al_italics._comment: Higher confidence for academic style — et al. italics is a hard rule in most citation formats.
et_al_italics.action: Replace plain 'et al.' with '*et al.*'. Standard in academic citation styles (APA, Chicago, etc.).
